text: Aboulia [Gr. a + boulh , will]: Ger. Abulie , Willenlosigkeit (- schwäche ); Fr. aboulie ; Ital. abulia . Loss or lack of the power to exercise will. The defect appears in a variety of forms, which are discussed in the article WILL (defects of). ( J.J. )
